verdict.rationale: Linear provides an API, webhooks, OAuth app support, and an 'integration directory' where agents/apps can be submitted for other workspaces to use (linear-docs-65, linear-docs-42, linear-docs-51), plus named integrations like GitHub, Slack, Okta. However, there is no evidence of a large-scale 'app marketplace' with thousands of third-party tools comparable to platforms like Zapier or Slack's app directory—only a developer-facing directory for custom agents/apps. Missing for 10: evidence of marketplace scale (thousands of listed apps), curated app store UI, and breadth of pre-built third-party integrations beyond a handful named tools.
